title: openai.system_fingerprint
description: OpenAI's backend-configuration fingerprint echoed on chat_completions response envelopes — pairs with the request `seed` to detect determinism-breaking backend changes. Provider-unique infrastructure metadata with no canonical home; rides ChatResponse.extensions with an EXTENSIONS FieldLoss so it is preserved and reported, never portable-by-pretense.
x-ocai-promotion: none expected (OpenAI has deprecated the field on newer model families)
